Only the connector + audit collection are LIVE. The 3-tier reporting ENGINE + default-deny serializer and the feedback CAPTURE/STORE/PULL are BUILT IN-REPO; the reporting hosted distribution (SWA+Entra+Slack/email) and the feedback AUTO-ALERT (Slack/email on new feedback) are DESIGNED·NEXT — zero code, must not be shown as live. (3) NEVER publish real person names on the public GitHub Pages site — the sample report data contains real Fourth names (Nipul Chokshi, Christian B., Carly H. etc.); use HMAC pseudonyms (U-xxxx) and counts only. Published HTML is grep-audited for all three. Reusable showcase patterns proven in ai-enablement-decks/fourthos/2026-06-24/deep-dive.html: interactive 'same data, three governed views' Leadership/IT/Governance toggle (per-user rows literally vanish at Leadership, demonstrating the S5 default-deny serializer) + the inheritance diagram ('build the mold once; every connector inherits identity·audit·reporting·feedback'). recent_learnings.content: FourthOS weekly publish model CORRECTION (supersedes earlier 'overwrite + archive' note): each promoted week is its OWN dated deck at ai-enablement-decks/fourthos/<YYYY-MM-DD>/ surfaced as a card in a dedicated 'sponsor-updates' section that is the FIRST section on the hub (decks.json sections[0], above mcp-capabilities/portfolio/etc). The hub index.html renderer was extended: sections with chronological:true sort cards newest-first; sections with collapsible:true get a JS post-pass that measures card offsetTop, keeps only the first visual row, collapses the rest behind a 'Show N earlier updates' toggle, and re-measures on resize. Only the newest sponsor card is featured. promote.mjs (scripts/fourthos-weekly/) reads fourthos/preview/card.json {tag,title,description,meta,date}, copies preview/ -> fourthos/<date>/, upserts the dated card, un-features older ones, validates+commits+pushes. Generate still stages to preview/ (unlisted); promote publishes the dated card. Verified live: section first, collapse fires (8 cards -> 1 row + toggle), no JS errors.
recent_learnings.context: User-directed revision after first build: sponsor updates need their own top hub section, chronological, one row visible with collapse. Pairing skill = .claude/skills/fourthos-weekly/SKILL.md (interactive generate/review/promote companion to CCv3-FourthOS-Weekly task).
